title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `html-webpack-plugin`
description: package.json declares a declared dependency name in package.json within one edit of `html-webpack-plugin`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The dependency graph an installer resolves comes from these names, so a name that only looks like the intended package pulls foreign code into the build. The name this rule expects is `html-webpack-plugin`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package.json (npm).
